people.name: Publius
people.line: Chief official of Malta who hosted Paul

translations.web: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us, and courteously entertained us for three days.
translations.bsb: Nearby stood an estate belonging to Publius, the chief official of the island. He welcomed us and entertained us hospitably for three days.
translations.kjv: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.
translations.asv: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us, and entertained us three days courteously.
